$comment: Copy to <project_root>/.audit-triage.json and fill in. Keep the copy out of git (it names your tracker queue and internal conventions) — add '.audit-triage.json' to your project .gitignore.

tracker.$comment: How triage-findings.md reaches your issue tracker. Leave tool_prefix and cli_command empty to work file-only — the plugin then never attempts tracker actions and only produces work-unit files + INDEX.md.

severity_to_priority.$comment: Map fr-security-review severities (crit/high/med/low) to your tracker's priority names.

trust_model.$comment: Answers pre-calibrate severity downgrades (Phase 0 of triage-findings.md) and are recorded as condition_keys on every unit they affect, instead of free text. Leave a value null to be asked at run time; fill in once you know the answer for this project and stop being asked.
